queen_margherita_1893.title: S. M. la Regina Margherita (dall’ultima fotografia di Guigoni e Bossi di Milano).jpg
queen_margherita_1893.credit: Mancastropa after Guigoni & Bossi, L'Illustrazione popolare (1893) / Wikimedia Commons
queen_margherita_1893.caption: Queen Margherita of Italy, engraved from a photograph (1893)
queen_margherita_1893.desc: Vertical engraved portrait, no border, detail even across the frame. No face detected, so the head position (centre, upper third) is a guess.

queen_margherita_photo.title: Queen Margherita of Italy - standing full length portrait.jpg
queen_margherita_photo.caption: Queen Margherita of Italy (photograph, before 1923)
queen_margherita_photo.desc: Full-length standing portrait, vertical, no border. Face detected centre, about a quarter of the way down (upper third); a weak second detection lower left is probably a false hit.

naples_santa_lucia_1860s.title: N.° 39. Napoli. Veduta di Santa Lucia - btv1b53264272j (1 of 2).jpg
naples_santa_lucia_1860s.credit: Roberto Rive / Bibliothèque nationale de France / Wikimedia Commons
naples_santa_lucia_1860s.caption: Santa Lucia, Naples, in the 1860s (photograph by Roberto Rive)
naples_santa_lucia_1860s.desc: Landscape albumen print with a thin border (about 2%). Pale sky in the top third; buildings and waterfront street across the middle (densest centre-left); quieter foreground.

naples_strada_santa_lucia.title: Strada di Santa Lucia in Napels met mensen op straat en drogend wasgoed P.e 1.a N.o 11316. NAPOLI - Strada di S. Lucia. (titel op object), RP-F-00-1657.jpg
naples_strada_santa_lucia.caption: Strada di Santa Lucia, Naples, with people in the street and laundry drying, about 1880-95 (Alinari)
naples_strada_santa_lucia.desc: Vertical albumen print on a slim mount edge. Street scene with detail spread through the frame, slightly stronger top and middle; people presumably along the street in the middle-lower area (a guess).

naples_via_roma.title: 1182 Napoli via Roma (titel op object) Napels (titel op object), RP-F-2007-358-26.jpg
naples_via_roma.caption: Via Roma (today's Via Toledo), Naples, with horse-drawn carriages, about 1893-1903 (Giorgio Sommer)
naples_via_roma.desc: Landscape street view with a thin border (about 3%). Strongest detail in the middle band and centre; carriages along the street, likely middle to lower centre.

naples_vicolo_pallonetto.title: Napoli-Vicolo del Pallonetto a Santa Lucia, RP-F-F16747.jpg
naples_vicolo_pallonetto.caption: Vicolo del Pallonetto, a narrow street in Santa Lucia, Naples, about 1880-1920 (Giacomo Brogi)
naples_vicolo_pallonetto.desc: Vertical photo with mount edges of about 4-7%. Alley receding through the centre; detail strongest lower right.

naples_from_vesuvius.title: Napels gezien vanaf de flanken van de Vesuvius Napoli dal Vesuvio (titel op object), RP-F-F01000-AO.jpg
naples_from_vesuvius.caption: Naples seen from the slopes of Vesuvius, about 1870-1900 (Giorgio Sommer)
naples_from_vesuvius.desc: Landscape view; quiet sky across the top third, city and bay in the middle and lower band, densest lower right.

naples_street_vendors.title: Naples – Street vendors at Santa Lucia (c.1900), by Fratelli Alinari.jpg
naples_street_vendors.caption: Street vendors at Santa Lucia, Naples, about 1900 (Alinari)
naples_street_vendors.desc: Landscape photo, no border; detail strongest in the middle band, vendors likely centre. A guess from the edge map.

macaroni_eaters.title: Sommer, Giorgio - Spagettiesser (Zeno Fotografie).jpg
macaroni_eaters.caption: Neapolitan street food: macaroni eaters, about 1870 (Giorgio Sommer)
macaroni_eaters.desc: Vertical posed street photo, no border; figures in the centre. A face was detected on another copy of this photo right of centre about two-thirds down, so the eaters sit low in the frame (treat as a guess).

bourcard_pizzaiuolo.title: BOURCARD(1858) p2.172 - IL PIZZAIUOLO.jpg
bourcard_pizzaiuolo.credit: F. Palizzi (attributed) / British Library / Wikimedia Commons
bourcard_pizzaiuolo.caption: 'Il Pizzaiuolo', the pizza maker: a plate from Usi e costumi di Napoli e contorni, vol. 2 (1858)
bourcard_pizzaiuolo.desc: Plate printed on a pale page (about 46% near-white); the scene sits centre and slightly low. Only 1000 px wide: keep push-ins light.

bourcard_title_page.title: VolumesecondoFrancescoDe Bourcard.jpg
bourcard_title_page.caption: Title page of Usi e costumi di Napoli e contorni, edited by Francesco de Bourcard, vol. 2
bourcard_title_page.desc: Photo of the printed title page filling the frame (no big border); text centred. Small (621 x 944): use on a card, no deep push-in.

pizzaiolo_print.title: PizzaioloPrint.jpg
pizzaiolo_print.caption: A Neapolitan pizza maker (19th-century print by Gaetano Dura)
pizzaiolo_print.desc: Vertical print with side margins (content about 10-87% across); figure centred. Under 1200 px: keep push-ins light.

brandi_plaque.title: TargaInvenzionePizzaMargheritaDaBrandi.jpg
brandi_plaque.caption: The plaque at Pizzeria Brandi in Naples that tells the pizza Margherita story (2019)
brandi_plaque.desc: Landscape photo, fairly dark; detail strongest top-left and top-centre, so the plaque likely sits upper left to centre (a guess).

brandi_plaque_2.title: Pizza Napoli Brandi.jpeg
brandi_plaque_2.credit: Uploader (permission confirmed by Wikimedia VRTS) / Wikimedia Commons
brandi_plaque_2.caption: A plaque in Naples about the invention of the pizza Margherita (Brandi)
brandi_plaque_2.desc: Close photo of a plaque filling most of the frame; slight dark strip on the right edge (about 8%). Text centred.

capodimonte_facade.title: Museo Capodimonte Napoli facciata Sudovest.jpg
capodimonte_facade.caption: The royal palace of Capodimonte, Naples (modern photograph)
capodimonte_facade.desc: Landscape; palace facade across the middle and lower bands, quiet sky in the top third. Facade spans the centre.

capodimonte_ballroom.title: Palace of Capodimonte (Naples) 03.jpg
capodimonte_ballroom.caption: The ballroom (Salone delle Feste) inside the palace of Capodimonte (modern photograph)
capodimonte_ballroom.desc: Wide interior; ornate detail across the whole frame, densest lower right; vanishing point likely centre.

pizza_margherita_naples.title: Pizza Margherita in Naples 2015.JPG
pizza_margherita_naples.caption: A pizza Margherita in Naples (modern photograph, 2015)
pizza_margherita_naples.desc: Landscape close photo; the pizza fills most of the frame, centred.

pizza_margherita_plate.title: Margherita pizza on plate.jpg
pizza_margherita_plate.caption: A pizza Margherita: tomato, mozzarella and basil (modern photograph)
pizza_margherita_plate.desc: Landscape close photo of a whole pizza on a plate; detail strongest top-left, pizza centred slightly left.

italian_flag.title: Flag of Italy.svg
italian_flag.caption: The Italian flag: green, white and red
italian_flag.desc: Flat tricolour in three vertical bands: green left third, white centre, red right third. SVG, renders cleanly at any size.

palace_letter.title: Lettera di ringraziamento a Raffaele Esposito.jpg
palace_letter.credit: Attributed to Camillo Galli (supposed); scan via BBC / Wikimedia Commons
palace_letter.caption: The supposed 1889 palace thank-you letter to Raffaele Esposito, which historian Zachary Nowak thinks is probably a later fake
palace_letter.desc: Tiny scan (312 x 399) of a handwritten page, mostly white (about 88%); text block centred. Too small for full-screen: use small on a card.
